item.title: Running the Everpure Cloud Azure Native VMSS Agent as a VM Application
item.description: Are you looking for a way to give every scale set instance its own Everpure Cloud Azure Native volume without running an Azure Function next to it? In Part 1 and Part 2 an orchestrator Function did the storage work while each instance called it on boot and on scale-in. This time the instance does all of it itself, and the agent that does it ships as a VM Application from an Azure Compute Gallery. I ran it on a single pool in one zone first, then across two zones with a pool in each.
